adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, which overcounts when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 50/50 => 2 pages). The `next` action then allows advancing, sets `offset` to `Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)` (so 50), and `Group.findMembers()` requests `offset=50` (see `models/group.js`), which `GroupsController#members` applies directly to `limit(...).offset(offset)`, yielding an empty members list. This is a real, diff-grounded off-by-one paging defect.
